overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board properly approved, at an August 31 meeting, a complaint response its counsel had drafted in advance, and no remedial order was issued.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to follow proper procedure in responding to a prior Open Meeting Law complaint.
allegations.key_passage: This procedure, where counsel prepared a response to the complaint in advance of the meeting for the Board’s consideration and approval at the meeting, satisfied the Board’s obligations under the Open Meeting Law.
